slides.title: Automotive SPICE
Introduction ASPICE
slides.body:
IntroductionASPICE -
Software Process Improvement and Capability Determination (Evaluation)
- Automotive SPICE is a domain-specific variant of the international standard ISO / IEC 15504 (SPICE).
- The purpose of Automotive SPICE is to improve and evaluate the performance of the development
processes of ECU suppliers in the automotive industry.

slides.title: Overview ASPICE - Requirement Elicitation System Requirement Analysis Software Requirement Analysis
slides.body:
OverviewASPICE -
Gather, process, and track evolving stakeholder needs and
requirements throughout the lifecycle of the product
Transform the defined stakeholder requirements into a set of
system requirements that will guide the design of the system
Transform the software related parts of the system requirements
into a set of software requirements

χ REQ1: If A != B, then initialization shall be triggered.
χ REQ2: The request for initialization shall be sent permanently with the value 0 (‘kein_init’).
 REQ: The request for initialization shall be sent permanently with

There should not be any conflicts between the requirements.
Avoid redundancy!

slides.title:  Clear and Unambiguous  Testable (verifiable)  Feasible  Consistent  Atomic  Traceable Characteristics Requirement
slides.body:
χ REQ: In case of overtemperature, overcurrent and overvoltage the system shall abort the charge.
 REQ1: In case of overtemperature the system shall abort the charge.
 REQ2: In case of overcurrent the system shall abort the charge.
 REQ3: In case of overvoltage the system shall abort the charge.
Requirements should be “singular” and include only one requirement with no use of
conjunctions.
